title: Rastelli 2025 · Experiment 3 · Affective brushing
citation: Rastelli, F., Ferroni, F., Langiulli, N., Crucianelli, L., Gallese, V., & Ardizzi, M. (2025). The spatial reach of affective touch: a new perspective on social peripersonal space. PsyArXiv, version 1.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.cohort: 35 participants completed the three explicitly numbered tasks in randomized order on one day.
published_method.carrier: 3 s looming sound. In the classic task, the pink-noise source is sampled at 44.1 kHz with an exponential level rise from 55 to 70 dB. The flat control is 62.5 dB.
published_method.analysis: Compare target reaction times across delays and estimate PSE. Collect separate verbal pleasantness ratings after the task.
published_method.brushing: Start manual soft-brush contact 2 s before the auditory carrier and continue for its 3 s duration. Alternate across two zones. Methods say hairy right hand, proximal to distal; the figure caption says arm, distal to proximal.
published_method.auditory_target: A 200 ms beep embedded in the 3 s carrier is the detection target.
published_method.anchor_ambiguity: The carrier onset is compatible with the delay table, while the Methods also refer to tactile onset. The manual brush leads the carrier, so anchors differ by 2 s.
published_method.trial_schedule: Two blocks and 124 nominal trials. The reported delay repetitions imply 72 paired and 36 auditory-target-only baseline trials, leaving 16 unallocated under those counts.
